candidates.title: RapidMoE: Exploiting Cross-Asymmetry via Adaptive Residual Offloading for Large-Scale MoE Inference
candidates.abstract: The widespread adoption of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has created a growing need for deployment on heterogeneous platforms. However, it exposes a fundamental mismatch between the algorithmic demands of large-scale MoE and the disparate characteristics of hardware.Existing CPU-GPU hybrid inference systems fail to resolve this as they either encounter PCIe bandwidth bottlenecks when loading experts to GPUs, or rely heavily on CPU computation. Consequently, this leads to low resource utilization and inevitable violations of fixed latency budgets as parameters scale. In this paper, we identify and exploit Cross-Asymmetry--a structural alignment between the algorithmic workload skew of MoE routing and the physical disparity of heterogeneous hardware. To this end, we introduce RapidMoE, a residual offloading system for efficient large-scale MoE inference. We propose how RapidMoE leverages a residual-split framework to enable offloading paradigm shift from expert-level to bit-level, which unfolds across three key dimensions: (1) data representation, enabling compact and decoupled storage; (2) routing strategy, partitioning computation into dual paths aligned with hardware capabilities; (3) execution parallelism, scheduling a balanced storage-compute workload across devices. We further employ a novel Unified Multi-Level Importance Arbitration to adaptively adjust the critical expert set at runtime, ensuring the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. These innovations exploit inherent cross-asymmetry, fundamentally breaking the algorithm-hardware misalignment. Experimental results show that RapidMoE achieves up to 3.5x speedup in decoding and 2.1x speedup in prefill compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) offloading systems.
candidates.reason: CPU-GPU混在環境での大規模MoE LLM推論を対象に、ルーティング重要度に応じた精度配分と重み残差の分割実行を協調させ、専門家単位の転送・計算ボトルネックを減らすシステムを提案する。DeepSeek-V3/R1とQwen3で推論精度、prefill/decode速度、serving遅延、メモリを評価しており、LLM推論のオフロード・圧縮・高速化に直接該当する。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv一次資料v1 (https://arxiv.org/html/2610.01265v1) の§1–6、§7 Discussion、§9 ConclusionおよびTables 2–10を確認。§3–4の核心は、router score・層別感度・prefill/decode相を統合して高精度処理対象rを実行時選択するUMIAと、量子化重みWQをGPU、残差WRをCPUに置くRESplit。選択された重要expertは両成分で補正し、他expertはWQで実行する。GLUの非線形性によりdown projectionはgate/upと同様に分割実行できず、downは二重量子化を採用し同期境界を設ける（§4.4–4.5）。§5–6ではDeepSeek-V3/R1-671BとQwen3-235Bを評価。主な構成はIntel Xeon、512GB DDR4、PCIe 4.0 x16と、2×A800-80GまたはRTX 4090複数枚。量子化はGPU側IQ1_M_R4 (平均1.75 bit)、CPU残差Q2_K_R4 (平均2.5 bit)で、合計4.25 bitとして4.5-bit Q4_K/AWQ相当の評価精度を報告。UMIAはWikiText-2から16 promptを校正し、100段階候補探索に約5時間かかる一回限りのコストを記載（§4.3、§5）。Table 5ではRapidMoEの各モデル・複数ベンチマーク精度はQ4_K_M比で概ね同等。§6.3/Table 8ではA800構成上のdecode throughputがKTransformers比でDeepSeek-R1 3.5倍、DeepSeek-V3 2.8倍、Qwen3 2.1倍、prefillは平均約2倍。4090構成でも最大2.9倍のdecode改善と報告。Table 9はShareGPT 1000要求、同時実行4、0.2 requests/sで、100ms TPOT・5秒TTFT双方を満たす要求はRapidMoE-C11で87.4%、C12で76.7%。Table 10ではDeepSeek-V3 C12のpeak DRAMがRapidMoE 240GB、KTransformers 385GB、MoE-APEX 471GB。§7は大batchでGPU throughputは改善する一方、CPU residual計算の恩恵が小さくTTFT/TPOTが悪化するため低同時実行のメモリ制約環境が主な対象と明記。評価はIntel CPU/NVIDIA GPUのPCIe構成であり、他backendへの移植はkernel対応次第、latencyモデルは各platformで再校正が必要、得られる改善はhardware依存とされる。候補のcanonical ID、title、URL、linked_fromは割当briefの値を保持。ローカルrepository cloneはHEAD 25364b0で、brief指定main SHAおよびworklistを含まないため、割当行との独立照合はできていない。

candidates.title: DRelay: Global Draft Context for Prefix-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding Repair
candidates.abstract: Parallel drafting reduces the drafting overhead of speculative decoding for large language models (LLMs), but its gains remain limited by the accepted prefix length. Even when the correct token is present in the candidate pool, a single early selection error prevents subsequent predictions from being used. We propose DRelay, which uses global information from the entire draft block to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before target-model verification. DRelay bases its decisions on candidate correlations and the selected path: a global reader extracts predictive information across positions for each candidate. While a causal selector combines candidate-level information extracted by the global read with the tokens selected at preceding positions to determine whether the native choice at the current position is consistent with the global evidence and the selected prefix. It then decides whether to retain or replace the token, thereby repairing early errors and extending the accepted prefix. We further jointly train the draft backbone and the selector, combining candidate-support learning with a repair objective, while weighting the repair loss according to each block position's potential contribution to the consecutive accepted prefix. Across eight diverse benchmarks on an H800 GPU, DRelay consistently improves both average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding performance over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark. Under SGLang serving, DRelay improves average end-to-end speedup over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark by 14.7%-16.8%, 8.7%-9.3%, and 8.1%-9.3%, respectively.
candidates.reason: 対象内。並列 speculative decoding の推論時に、ドラフトブロック内の全位置から候補別の文脈を読む Global Read と、選択済み prefix に沿って各位置のKEEP/REPAIRを決めるCausal Selectorで早期の誤選択を修復し、検証で受理される連続prefixを伸ばす手法を提案・評価している。学習目的も候補supportとrepairを共同最適化する。
candidates.library_body_check: 一次資料 v1 の本文HTML (https://arxiv.org/html/2610.01439v1) を確認。§3ではDFlash/DominoのQwen3-4B native traceで最初の誤り時に正解がtop-16候補に残る割合 (94.0%/95.1%; Domino served path 88.8%)、実際の後続4 tokenを使った候補識別のcorrectness-matched control比改善 (53.5/44.4 percentage points)、oracle one-edit診断の受理長増分 (全complete blocks平均1.65/1.22 token)を示すが、著者はこれらを学習済み性能とは区別している。§4の機構は候補分布のslot mixingとcandidate-specific global attentionの後、verified historyと選択prefixを参照して位置順にkeep/repairし、targetが単一経路を検証する構成。§5ではdrafterとselectorを共同学習し、prefix reach/continuation価値によるbounded repair weightingを使う。§6.1-6.3はQwen3-4B/8B、温度0/1、8 dataset (GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME25, HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, MT-Bench, Alpaca)を対象とし、8xH800でPerfectBlend 1.42Mを学習、単一H800で推論、H=15/K=16。Table 1でAR比の8-dataset平均speedupは2.81x (Qwen3-4B, temp 1)から3.89x (Qwen3-8B, temp 0); §1/Abstractは最良baseline比平均7.8-9.9%を報告。§6.2 latency breakdownはselector追加0.55ms、共通処理6.38msに対し合計6.93ms (+8.6%対DFlash 6.38ms; Domino 6.99ms)。Table 2はgreedy AIME25/HumanEvalの並行servingで、concurrency 32時のAR比speedupが4Bで2.34x/2.27x、8Bで2.63x/2.89x。§6.3 ablationでNo Global Readはaccepted length 7.58から7.16へ低下。§7、Appendix A/Cは制約を明記: selector overheadとH個の逐次判断の費用をprefix利得が上回る必要があり、実験対象はQwen3-4B/8B・指定8 dataset・H800に限られる。Appendix A/Cのcoverage、future-continuation、one-edit診断はoffline/oracle分析であり、selectorがfirst-error位置や未検証future target tokenを使えること、またはoracle gainが学習済みend-to-end gainを予測することを示さない。

candidates.title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.abstract: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.
candidates.reason: LLM推論時のprojection計算をactivation sparsityで削減する手法を扱う。学習不要のTopK-Guided maskingと感度に基づくblock別sparsity配分を既存WINAへ加え、TEAL/WINA比較で同じ目標計算削減に対する品質改善を評価しているため、推論効率化の対象範囲に直接該当する。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv HTML v1本文を確認。§1–2: threshold法TEALはtokenごとに自然適応する一方、実現sparsityが目標からずれる。WINAは各tokenで固定数をTopK選択して目標を厳密に守る一方、token適応性がない。提案法は較正thresholdからtoken別自然sparsityを見積もり、目標の±δ（δ=0.01）へclip後にTopK選択する。また較正passでblock出力の相対誤差を測り、敏感なblockへ低く頑健なblockへ高くglobal budgetを再配分する。decode時のper-token maskとsparsity制御で、重みは変更しない。§3/Table 1: 単一NVIDIA A100 SXM4 40GB上でLlama-2-7B/Llama-3-8B、target sparsity 0.3/0.5/0.7を評価し、C4 perplexity (500 validation samples) と8 zero-shot tasksの平均精度を報告。全12条件でTEAL/WINA双方よりperplexityと平均精度が良く、改善幅はs=0.7で大きい。著者はWINAとほぼ同じprojection FLOP削減、per-token O(d) mask overheadは小さいと説明するが、wall-clock speedupは測定していない。§4: decoder-only最大8Bのみで、他の規模/architectureは未検証。kernel-level実装と実速度評価はfuture work。
